0022600017.text: The Brooklyn Nets (0-4, on a four-game losing streak and 15th in the East) host the Detroit Pistons (4-1, first in the East and in the Central) in an Emirates NBA Cup East Group A regular-season game, Brooklyn's fifth of the season. Tyler Bilodeau is out for the Nets with a shoulder sprain, and Egor Demin is day-to-day with a leg bruise and is a game-time decision. For Detroit, Jalen Duren is out with a hamstring strain, and Isaiah Joe is day-to-day with a hip bruise and is also a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Nets lost the season series 1-3, including a 138-100 defeat in Brooklyn on March 10, 2026.
